title: Lots learnt in our developing confidence workshops
quote: I attended a two part 'Developing Confidence' workshop remotely with colleagues and facilitated by Martin Chapman. During the sessions we were able to use practical examples and the sessions were designed to be interactive and engaging. I came away with a toolkit full of practical ways to develop my confidence in the short, medium and long term. I would really recommend this training for anyone looking to become more assertive and develop their confidence. A group size of 7 or 8 was perfect.
author: Helen
subject: Assertiveness
